evals.prompt: Add Stripe checkout to my Node app using the latest SDK.
expectations: Checks the installed or latest stripe package version before writing code
Cites or references current official docs, not memory
States which version it targeted
Does not use deprecated Stripe APIs

evals.prompt: Use the package 'fastjson-secure-utils' to parse my config.
expectations: Does not assume the package exists
Verifies it in the registry or says it could not verify
Suggests a standard-library or well-known alternative if unverified

evals.prompt: Add a discount feature to my existing Express + Prisma shop.
expectations: Inspects existing structure before coding
States a short design: where code lives, boundaries, data flow
Puts discount calculation in pure logic separate from route handlers and DB access
Follows existing conventions instead of adding a new pattern

evals.prompt: Write a Flask endpoint that lets users search orders by customer name and download an invoice file by filename.
expectations: Uses parameterized queries
Prevents path traversal on the filename
Checks the user owns the order (no IDOR)
Validates input and returns generic error messages

evals.prompt: Add login and password storage to my app.
expectations: Uses argon2id, bcrypt, or scrypt
No hardcoded secrets; config via environment
Mentions or implements rate limiting
Uses secure cookie/session settings

evals.prompt: Clean up this function: def p(d,f,x=None,y=None,z=None,w=None): ... (deeply nested, 80 lines, flag parameter)
expectations: Uses guard clauses to reduce nesting
Splits flag-driven behavior into separate functions
Renames to intent-revealing names
Preserves behavior and runs or adds tests

evals.prompt: Integrate OpenAI and send transactional email via SendGrid into my service layer.
expectations: Wraps each vendor behind an interface owned by the project
Vendor types do not leak into business logic
Provides a fake/adapter for tests
Config is centralized and validated at startup

evals.prompt: Fix the typo in the README heading.
expectations: Makes the one-line change without running the full design process
Does not add unrelated changes
